title: 交通工学
subtitle: Traffic Engineering
educationalGoal:
Students will:
1) learn the historical development of rail and roads in Japan.
2) acquire knowledge of traffic volume estimation and countermeasure against traffic jam.
3) acquire knowledge of the Road Structure Ordinance, and understand the design of road alignment.
4) acquire knowledge of pavement structure and its design method.
advice:
This course provides basic knowledge of the following theme mainly:

1. Concept and law of City Planning
2. Traffic flow and volume estimation and traffic jam
3. Traffic engineering
4. Outline of the Road Structure Ordinance
5. Road engineering
6. Pavement engineering (Structure, Design, Materials and O&M)
7. AI-based road surface survey.
requiredKnowledge: No special knowledge is required to take this course.
